fields.label: Routing Provider
fields.description: Google previews send coordinates to Google and incur request charges; dedicated optimization is billed per routing location. Applied allocation routes retain Google-calculated distance and application-calculated cost estimates. Set Google Cloud quotas as well as the application limits below.

fields.label: Mobile Map Provider
fields.description: Automatic follows Routing Provider; Google Maps bills the project owning this site's mobile key. Fully close and reopen the app after changing the key or customer site.

fields.label: Android Google Maps API Key
fields.description: Customer-owned mobile key, restricted to the Android package and release signing SHA-1; enable Maps SDK for Android and Navigation SDK. Shared only with approved driver devices, never used for server routing.

fields.label: iOS Google Maps API Key
fields.description: Customer-owned mobile key, restricted to the iOS bundle ID; enable the required Google Maps and Navigation SDKs. Changing the key or customer site requires fully closing and reopening the app.

fields.label: Google Routes API Key
fields.description: Optional server-restricted key; otherwise uses API Key in Google Settings. Enable Routes API and billing in Google Cloud.

fields.label: Allow Driver Road Routes
fields.description: Allows assigned drivers to show their trip's road route without planning permissions.

fields.label: Daily Driver Route Preview Requests
fields.description: Daily requests for drivers to display trip road routes, shared across all drivers; split routes use multiple requests and also count toward Daily Routing Requests — Desk and Mobile. Failed attempts count.

fields.label: Allow In-App Google Navigation
fields.description: Requires Navigation SDK and billing in the app's Google Cloud project. Standard driving only; heavy/large-vehicle use requires Google's authorization or a provisioned supported solution.

fields.label: Daily Driver Navigation Starts
fields.description: Daily authorized attempts to start turn-by-turn navigation, shared across all drivers; navigating to five stops uses five starts. Failed attempts count; these starts are separate from route preview requests.

fields.label: Google Service Account JSON
fields.description: Enable Route Optimization API and grant this service account routeoptimization.locations.use, for example through the Route Optimization Viewer role.

fields.label: Routing Access and Usage
fields.description: Daily allowances are shared across this site and reset at midnight in the site's timezone. These are application safeguards, not spending caps; also configure Google Cloud quotas and billing alerts.

fields.label: Maximum Stops per Route
fields.description: Maximum destination stops in one route preview or optimization, excluding the starting location and return to start; this is not a daily allowance. Up to 200 stops are supported.

fields.label: Allowed Routing Roles
fields.description: Leave empty for System Manager, Transport Manager, Transport Dispatcher and Transport Planner.

fields.label: Daily Routing Requests — Desk and Mobile
fields.description: Combined daily server requests for Desk previews, driver route previews and stop optimization; a split route uses multiple requests. Failed attempts count; turn-by-turn navigation starts do not.

fields.label: Daily Stops Submitted for Optimization
fields.description: Total destination stops submitted for stop-order optimization each day; optimizing 40 stops twice uses 80 of this allowance. Failed attempts count; ordinary route previews do not.

fields.label: Allow Driver to Receive Supplier Collections
fields.description: Submitting collection proof posts a Purchase Receipt into the vehicle's Transit Warehouse.

fields.label: Allow Driver to Complete Depot Transfers
fields.description: Submitting delivery proof posts the End Transit Stock Entry; otherwise warehouse staff post it.

fields.label: Allow Unplanned Return Pickups
fields.description: Allow drivers to record collections without an approved Return Request.
